hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
cleanup() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; } trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" }
reset_dir() { local d="$1" rm -rf "$d" mkdir -p "$d" }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs + required inputs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need tail need java
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}" : "${metadata_file:?metadata_file must be set (s3://.../metadata.json)}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
# ----------------------------- # Workspace layout (cleanly) # ----------------------------- reset_dir data reset_dir completed reset_dir hierarchies reset_dir processing rm -rf pic-sure-hpds || true
mkdir -p data/raw data/decoded
# ----------------------------- # Assume role once for all S3 ops # ----------------------------- ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}" assume_role
# ----------------------------- # Pull managed inputs + metadata + counts # ----------------------------- log "Downloading managed inputs -> data/Managed_Inputs.csv" aws s3 cp "$managed_inputs" "data/Managed_Inputs.csv" --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Downloading metadata_file -> data/metadata.json" aws s3 cp "$metadata_file" "data/metadata.json" --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Syncing counts -> data/" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/counts/" "data/" --recursive --no-progress --only-show-errors
# ----------------------------- # Build inputs.csv (add Has Multi) # ----------------------------- log "Building inputs.csv" csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Version","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi" \ "data/Managed_Inputs.csv" > inputs.csv
log "inputs.csv preview:" head -n 6 inputs.csv >&2 || true
# ----------------------------- # Download raw/decoded multi files only for ready+unprocessed+has_multi=yes # ----------------------------- DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL="${DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL:-6}" log "Downloading study multi files with parallelism=${DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL}"
download_multi_files() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" version="$3" local abv_lc stdy_lc abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" stdy_lc="$(printf '%s' "$stdy_id" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
log "Getting raw dictionary files for ${stdy_id} (${abv_name})" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/rawData/" "data/raw/" \ --recursive --no-progress --only-show-errors --exclude "*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*ubject*data_dict*.xml*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*ample*data_dict*.xml*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*subject.multi*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Subject.Multi*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Subject.MULTI*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*sample.multi*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Sample.Multi*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Sample.MULTI*"
log "Getting subject/sample multi files for ${stdy_id} (${abv_name})" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/decoded_data/" "data/decoded/" \ --recursive --no-progress --only-show-errors --exclude "*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*ubject*data_dict*.xml*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*ample*data_dict*.xml*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*subject.multi*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Subject.Multi*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Subject.MULTI*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*sample.multi*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Sample.Multi*" \ --include "${stdy_id}*${version}*Sample.MULTI*"
log "Done downloading multi files for ${stdy_id}" }
while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id version stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi; do abv_name="${abv_name%\"}"; abv_name="${abv_name#\"}" stdy_id="${stdy_id%\"}"; stdy_id="${stdy_id#\"}" version="${version%\"}"; version="${version#\"}" data_ready="${data_ready%\"}"; data_ready="${data_ready#\"}" data_processed="${data_processed%\"}"; data_processed="${data_processed#\"}" has_multi="${has_multi%\"}"; has_multi="${has_multi#\"}"
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" == "yes" ]] && [[ "${data_processed,,}" == "no" ]] && [[ "${has_multi,,}" == "yes" ]]; then while [[ "$(jobs -pr | wc -l)" -ge "$DOWNLOAD_PARALLEL" ]]; do sleep 0.2; done download_multi_files "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" "$version" & fi done < <(tail -n +2 inputs.csv | csvformat -U 1)
log "Waiting for all downloads to finish..." wait log "All downloads complete"
# ----------------------------- # Generate metadata # ----------------------------- log "Running JsonMetadataGenerator.jar" java -jar jars/JsonMetadataGenerator.jar
# ----------------------------- # Upload result # ----------------------------- OUT_FILE="completed/metadata.json" if [[ ! -s "$OUT_FILE" ]]; then error "Expected output not found or empty: ${OUT_FILE}" exit 255 fi
log "Uploading ${OUT_FILE} -> s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata_new_search.json" aws s3 cp "$OUT_FILE" "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata_new_search.json" --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Done"
